The range

LED mirrors and shaving cabinets

An LED mirror lights your face evenly and needs no separate wall light. A shaving cabinet gives you storage at eye level and keeps the vanity top clear. This page lists 50 LED mirrors, 98 shaving cabinets, 38 framed mirrors and 22 plain mirrors.

LED mirror or shaving cabinet: which suits your bathroom?

LED mirrorShaving cabinet
StorageNone. It is a mirror onlyShelves behind the mirror doors
DepthSlim, around 35 mm on the framed and backlit models listedAbout 150 to 160 mm deep on the cabinets listed
LightingBuilt-in backlight, with touch controls on many modelsPlain mirror doors on most. 14 cabinets here have LED lighting
InstallationHung on the wall. Needs power at the mirrorFixed to the wall, or recessed where the wall allows. LED models need power

Depths are taken from the product descriptions on this page.

Pricing

Mirror and cabinet prices

5 LED mirrors show their price on this site, from $350 to $718. The Round LED Mirror is $370 to $530 depending on its size, and the Arch and Oval LED mirrors are $450 each.

The shaving cabinets, framed mirrors and the wider LED range show Enquire Now, and the team confirms the price for the size and finish you choose.

Sizes

Round, rectangle and arch mirror sizes

The Round LED Mirror comes in five sizes from 600 to 900 mm across. The rectangle LED mirror runs from 600 x 700 mm to 1200 x 800 mm. Arch and oval mirrors are tall shapes, listed at sizes such as 600 x 900 mm.

Shaving cabinets are listed from 450 to 1500 mm wide, with one to four doors, so there is one to sit above most vanity widths.

Features

Anti-fog glass, touch controls and colour temperature

The priced LED mirrors are described as backlit, with touch free controls and copper-free glass that resists fogging. They offer three light colours: daylight at 6,000 K, cool white at 4,000 K and warm light at 3,000 K.

A cooler light is better for shaving and make-up. A warmer light is easier on the eyes at night. An LED bathroom mirror with all three lets you switch between them.

Availability

Mirror and cabinet availability

Send the product name or code, the size and the frame finish, and the team confirms what can be supplied and when. If you are searching for LED mirrors in Sydney to suit a vanity you have already ordered, tell us the vanity width as well.

Matching

Matching a mirror to your vanity width

A mirror looks right when it is the same width as the vanity or a little narrower. Above a 900 vanity, a 900 mm cabinet or a mirror of 750 to 900 mm works well. Above a double vanity, use one wide mirror or one round mirror over each basin.

Check the height between the top of the tap and the ceiling or cornice. If you are still choosing the cabinet below, see vanities first.

Electrical

Electrical and warranty

LED mirrors and LED cabinets need a power supply at the wall. Many are described as supplied with a hardwire lead and plug. Any fixed wiring must be done by a licensed electrician, so plan the power point or cable before the wall is tiled.

The priced LED mirrors are listed with a 1 year warranty on the mirror and a 50,000 hour life on the light strip. Ask us for the warranty terms of other models.

Getting it

Delivery and pick-up

Mirrors travel flat and well packed, but they are still glass. Collect from the Bonnyrigg showroom with a vehicle that lets the box lie flat or stand upright against a firm surface, or ask about delivery across Sydney metro.

Shaving cabinets in Sydney homes are often recessed between wall studs. If you plan to recess one, give your builder the cabinet size before the wall is sheeted.

The range

Poseidon mirrors

The mirrors and cabinets come from the Poseidon and KDK Home range. Framed mirrors are listed in matte black, brushed gold, brushed nickel and gun metal, in round, oval and arch shapes. Shaving cabinets include the Fremantle, Stella, Nova and Evie series, which share their names with vanity ranges.

You can browse bathroomware to see the matching vanities and tallboys.

Care

Cleaning a bathroom mirror

Spray glass cleaner onto a soft cloth, not onto the mirror, and wipe. Liquid that runs to the edge can creep behind the glass and damage the backing over time.

Wipe the frame with a damp cloth and dry it. Avoid abrasive cleaners on coloured frames, and match your towel hooks to the frame with the accessories range.

Mirrors

Mirror and shaving cabinet questions

What size mirror goes over a 900 vanity?

A mirror or shaving cabinet between 750 and 900 mm wide suits a 900 vanity. Keeping it the same width or slightly narrower than the vanity looks balanced.

Do LED mirrors need an electrician?

An LED mirror needs power at the wall. If it is hard-wired, or a new power point is needed, that work must be done by a licensed electrician. A mirror with a plug can use an existing power point if one is within reach.

What is a demister pad?

A demister pad is a thin heating element behind the mirror glass that stops it fogging after a shower. The LED mirrors on this page are described as resisting fogging. Ask us whether the model you like has a heated demister.

mainEntity.name: What size mirror goes over a 900 vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: A mirror or shaving cabinet between 750 and 900 mm wide suits a 900 vanity. Keeping it the same width or slightly narrower than the vanity looks balanced.
